thread:
Ravi (product): Quick sync on the bulk rotate + revoke UX. Sketch: bulk action on creds table -> modal -> choose Rotate / Soft revoke / Hard revoke -> optional CSV export of affected services. Need to cover permissions and empty-state flow.
Sana (design): Two main concerns: modal overload (too many options) and mobile/tablet layout for bulk actions. Thinking of a two-step modal: 1) review list, 2) choose action + confirm.
Liam (eng): Backend supports bulk rotate as job: POST /v1/keys/bulk-actions {action: rotate, ids: [...]} returns job_id. Soft revoke = mark as inactive but keep secret valid for a grace period. Hard revoke = immediate secret invalidation.
Noor (security): Security prefers default = Rotate, then Soft revoke as secondary. Soft revoke is useful to avoid outage but we need clear guidance about grace period (7 days by default). Also need admin audit + optional forced MFA for rotation initiation.
Bea (content): Microcopy suggestions: primary CTA when Rotate = "Rotate selected keys"; Soft revoke CTA = "Disable for now". Inline helper copy: "Soft revoke pauses new issuance but existing sessions may continue until grace period ends."
Ollie (a11y): Confirm keyboard and screenreader flow for multi-select table -> open modal -> focus lands on summary. Provide aria-describedby linking to the warning. For mass actions requiring confirmation, require typing the word "CONFIRM" only for Hard revoke. Avoid modal-within-modal.
Sana (design): Empty state: when user has no keys selected or no keys at all. Two variants: 1) no keys selected -> hint: "Select one or more credentials to take action" with disabled bulk button; 2) no credentials in org -> empty illustration + CTA "Create API key" + short explainer about scopes.
Ravi (product): Permissions note: users without "key.manage" should see button disabled with tooltip "Request permission" linking to request flow. For org admins we show "Force revoke" option.
Liam (eng): Implementation note: job returns per-key status; UI should stream updates and allow cancel of the job if rotate is long. We can show per-key rows with status icons and links to job logs.
Noor (security): Error states: if a key is tied to Dedicated infra, communicate: "Action pending admin approval: key used in Dedicated deployment". Also policy mismatch: if destination org policy forbids external keys, return 409 with reason. UI should surface exact reason.
Bea (content): Toast language: on success: "Bulk rotate started — 12 keys. View progress." Link -> job detail. On partial failure: "Rotation started for 9 keys; 3 failed. View details."
Ollie (a11y): Progress region should use role=status and aria-live=polite updates for incremental row changes. For cancel action confirm via accessible dialog.
Sana (design): Visual: use a condensed compact modal for >50 keys to avoid huge scroll; show batch summary: count, estimated time, impact level. Offer "export CSV" prior to action.
Ravi (product): Decision needed: default action = Rotate (security-favored) or Soft revoke (availability-favored)? Leaning Rotate but surface a clear warning about potential rotation fallout.
Noor (security): We vote Rotate default. Add explicit checkboxes: "Notify owners" and "Auto-create new secret and update UI (recommended)".
Liam (eng): For auto-update we can generate new secrets and optionally output a CSV with new values. Note: don't show raw secrets in UI unless user copies them immediately; we need ephemeral reveal with one-time copy and audit event.
Sana (design): Mobile consideration: if user starts bulk rotate on phone, collapse per-key details and show summary only; allow viewing a few examples before confirming.
ops-bot: Job queued -> JOB-2179123-77, status=queued
Ravi (product): Action items: @Sana prototype two-step modal + compact large-batch view, @Bea draft all helper copy and toasts, @Ollie create a11y checklist for bulk flows, @Liam return API error codes and job streaming contract, @Noor confirm default policy + grace period text. Review next Tues. :rocket:
